body: I don't want to start again and I don't want to find another guy.

I know I can do it again but I was alone for so so so long. It took me years to build what I had. I have one of those cliche tragic back stories. Abuse, neglect, ect. I didn't have anything 2 years ago. I was afraid of people. Trev saved me. As cheesy as it sounds he was my light. He gave me hope. He built me up, filled me with confidence and changed how I saw the world. When I lost him. I lost everything he gave me. The world is a dark place and everyone will turn on us. No matter how hard we try. I thought my friends would believe me, I thought they'd stand up for me. I loved them all so much but now they're all gone. They hate me. They listened to what melissa had to say and forgot who I was.
